answer_1.quote: Systems that automatically generate text suggestions to human authors have emerged as a new application of natural language generation models.

answer_2.quote: we run standard automatic evaluations of text quality on the collaboratively-generated text and get results consistent with previous analyses of "statically"-generated text.

answer_4.quote: We run CYOA on Amazon Mechanical Turk with 105 Turkers to compare the two models. Each Turker can only complete the task once.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked to indicate on a 5-point Likert scale how much they agreed with statements including: I'm happy with my final story; I felt the system and I were working collaboratively; The suggestions helped me come up with new ideas. They also answer open-ended questions: What made you choose one suggestion over another? What were you looking for in the suggestions?
